nodes.name: New Order Webhook
nodes.notes: This receives order data from Supabase webhook. In Supabase: Database → Webhooks → Create new → Table: orders → Event: INSERT → URL: your-n8n-url/webhook/hype-new-order

nodes.name: Telegram — Notify Owner
nodes.notes: Setup: 1) Create bot via @BotFather on Telegram 2) Get your chat ID by messaging @userinfobot 3) Add bot credentials in n8n

nodes.name: Google Sheet — Log Order
nodes.notes: Create a Google Sheet with columns: Order ID, Date, Customer Name, Phone, Email, Items, Total Amount, Payment Status, Order Status, Delivery Address, Payment ID

_setup_instructions.step1_supabase_webhook: In Supabase → Database → Webhooks → Create New: Table=orders, Events=INSERT, URL=https://your-n8n.com/webhook/hype-new-order
_setup_instructions.step2_telegram_bot: Message @BotFather on Telegram → /newbot → get your Bot Token → Add to n8n Credentials → Then message your bot and check https://api.telegram.org/botYOUR_TOKEN/getUpdates to get your chat_id
_setup_instructions.step3_google_sheets: Create a new Google Sheet → Add columns (Order ID, Date, Customer Name, Phone, Email, Items, Total Amount, Payment Status, Order Status, Delivery Address, Payment ID) → Copy Sheet ID from URL → Add Google OAuth credentials in n8n
_setup_instructions.step4_import: In n8n → Workflows → Import → paste this JSON → Update YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID and YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID → Activate workflow
